noncompensatory_entry_gates.rule: An exact executable code/configuration/parameter hash binding to the same frozen M1-pass candidate must exist.
At least 3 independently certified public/development Night-1 personalized models for the exact candidate must be available before any Phase2B outcome access.
The exact executable candidate must have M1_PASS, VERIFIED, MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false, and matching hashes.
Sham, leave-one-subject-out matched non-personalized, and deterministic cyclic wrong-subject comparators must all be executable for every included subject.
Synthetic draws, nominal bench variants, labels, or simulated pseudo-subjects cannot contribute to the formal subject denominator.

current_campaign_decision.reason: Entry gates A0-A3 are not estimable under the certified current inputs. The target ranking algorithm is therefore not entered.

eligibility_filter: Target has valid complete Phase2A Level A evidence with at least 30 paired seed-draw blocks.
Target meets its registered practical margin and simultaneous uncertainty threshold.
At least 95 percent of prescribed runs are stable.
No target-specific or global off-target hard veto fires.
Independent verifier status is VERIFIED and MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false.
Target grade is C or better under the registered A/B/C/D/F definitions.
T8 is excluded because it is prospectively exploratory in Candidate V1.

score_components.reproducibility: fraction of valid paired blocks with target-oriented effect in the registered direction
score_components.specificity: 1 minus the maximum normalized adverse off-target magnitude, clipped to [0,1]
score_components.stability: fraction of prescribed runs passing all stability rules

sort_keys: lower simultaneous confidence-bound margin slack descending
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.selection: Take the first min(3,number_eligible) targets after sorting; do not fill unused slots.
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.policy_freeze: For each selected target, the subject-specific policy is the smallest-absolute-dose maximizer of the registered training-seed benefit on the fixed grid; signed ties use the smaller numeric dose. Evaluation uses disjoint seeds.

required_new_version_for_future_eligibil.condition: A new exact governance-approved release supplies at least 3 eligible public/development Night-1 models and an exact same-candidate executable/hash binding before relevant outcomes are visible.
required_new_version_for_future_eligibil.action: Create and independently audit a new protocol version; Candidate V1 remains NOT_ESTIMABLE and its empty advancement decision remains immutable.
